data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 (program eval with typed lease-mismatch code) abstracts SRC_004's (async post-call mutation) enforcement mechanism: SRC_005 requires only the assertion of a typed code before the provider call, while SRC_004 specifies the full mutation to move the check after the call. The abstraction is refuted if SRC_005's program eval does not cover the async mutation described in SRC_004, or if SRC_004's mutation requires evaluating the provider call outcome, which is outside SRC_005's synchronous-precondition scope.
